explanation: The folklore conjecture: for odd primes p, the only integer solutions of x² − 2 = y^p are (±1, −1). Katz–Pratt (arXiv:2507.12397) prove it for p ≤ 13 and p > 911, and show nontrivial solutions have y > 10^{1000}, so the full statement (17 ≤ p ≤ 907 remaining) is open. The iff encodes "these are the only solutions" correctly. The statement is faithful.
